# Reconcile Changes

The reconcile function processes changes made in a repository by comparing merged pull requests and direct commits since the last successful compile. It ensures that all changes are reflected in the compiled knowledge and provides a summary of the results.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.reconcile`
